summary: Report-to-event step for the 'institution or message' fork. Pinned Matthew 16 and 18, John 21 (same Perseus witnesses) and Dei Verbum ch. V (vatican.va web snapshot), and read Matthew 16, 18, 28 and John 20, 21 in full. Derived the narrow scope premise from a historical premise (Matthew 28.18-20 and at least one of the four governing commissions go back to Jesus; Dei Verbum §19) and a link premise (a governing power and the power to teach, if Jesus gave them, make his founding of the Catholic Church a founding in the mandate with a teaching commission; Lumen gentium §§19, 22). The link premise is strictly weaker than the narrow premise but carries the institutional content in its consequents, so the result is recorded as a transcription (single application; Codex review on #581). The fork is split: the message rival may deny the link premise, or, granting it with Jesus' mandate and his founding of the Catholic Church, must deny each of the four governing commissions; it may keep Matthew 28. Findings from the text: Matthew 16.18-19 is a promise in the future tense (oikodomēsō, dōsō); Matthew 16.18 and 18.17 are the only Gospel uses of ekklēsia; only Matthew 28.18 and John 20.21 ground the commission in Jesus' own received authority or sending; only Matthew 28.20 names teaching; recipients differ (Peter; the disciples of 18.1; the eleven; the disciples without Thomas; Peter). Rejected: (i) a premise that all five reports go back to Jesus (stronger than needed; Dei Verbum's reading is kept only as the implying statement); (ii) counting teaching or baptizing as governing, which would make the rival's Matthew 28 concession institutional and beg the question; (iii) a separate premise that the commissions were given in the mandate (Matthew 28.18, John 20.21): no recorded rival separates it, so it stays inside the link premise (decomposition gate); (iv) report statements as premises: their content is fixed by the sourced definition DEF-COMMISSION-REPORT-POWERS. Not found: a pinned source stating the historical denial of the governing sayings (Harnack's pinned section does not discuss them). As a transcription with open premises it leaves the narrow premise open; reaching the root, the two new premises are listed beside it (61 → 63 open premises, bare unchanged); route costs unchanged (cheapest 31); nothing discharged. Definition/endpoint audit (2026-11-06): the raw OnlyMessage thesis denies institutional founding in a mandate, not the actual grant/promise of commission powers. A nonempty model retains OnlyMessage and the full historical bundle while the institutional transfer fails. Replaced its automatic alternative endpoint with the exact report-bundle negation, derived only from the raw rival, the weak governing-event component of the old institutional bridge, and an actual mandate/founded-visible-body witness. The original teaching component is not needed for this confrontation. A checked structural transfer-or-positive-countercase fork identifies the actual omitted option; Matthew28 remains compatible. Existing nine-power table, source claims, Challenges and root routes are unchanged. Report-to-event truth and institutional applicability remain open. The sibling alternative to Catholic-only mandate scope had the same hidden actual-witness guard: two conditional universals coexist when no mandate is held. Its endpoint is now exact scope negation, proved from rawOnlyMessage plus the actual mandate/body witness by importing FoundingScope.messageRival_excludes_scope. Separate empty/nonempty controls preserve that boundary. Strength self-sweep: the old attestation route does not need the link teaching component, so a same-target weak-link sibling imports attestation_gives_governing and the new nonvacuous contradiction result; the frozen legacy interface is retained honestly. By contrast the original narrow-scope conclusion still needs both a teaching grant and a teaching-commission transfer. Two explicit nonempty omission controls retain full historical reports with a weak link, or a full link with only a governing grant, and fail teaching scope. Updated exact strong-version notes without inventing logical necessity for the attestation interface.
